paisley.snapshot: Paisley sits inside an active Renfrewshire full-fibre build, and the trade splits two ways. National build contractors and established cabling firms run fleets of engineers and order through trade accounts, while ex-BT sole traders and one-van broadband and CCTV installers buy a few branded pieces direct online with no account. We run both routes side by side so the fleet and the lone installer are kitted alike across Paisley.
paisley.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Renfrewshire
s1loc: Paisley is in the middle of a Renfrewshire full-fibre push. CityFibre has built a 1Gbps network across Paisley, Renfrew and Johnstone, going live through Ferguslie, Millarston, Foxbar and the town centre, while Openreach extends its own full fibre to the majority of premises in the PA postcode area. GoFibre and the other Scottish alternative networks are active across the wider region, and Virgin Media and the mobile operators keep upgrading on top. Renfrewshire Council has backed a large connectivity agreement wiring around 180 public sites, so build crews are working streets and cabinets right across the town.

Alongside the residential rollout sits a solid commercial scene. Structured-cabling and fibre firms wire offices, schools and multi-site businesses in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre around Paisley town centre, the Hillington and Inchinnan estates toward Renfrew, and the University of the West of Scotland campus. CCTV installers cover retail and industrial units across Linwood and Glasgow Airport businesses nearby. It is a mix of larger cabling contractors and a long tail of independent broadband and CCTV engineers taking on work for homes and businesses across the town.
